title: The top-dimensional current [[G]] = τ(G, 1, e_0∧⋯∧e_{n−1}) of a Borel set G ⊆ ℝⁿ is integer multiplicity
statement:
Conventions: ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n). Hⁿ = μHE[n], Mathlib's normalized Euclidean Hausdorff measure; on ℝⁿ it equals Lebesgue measure. 𝒟ⁿ(ℝⁿ) = TestFormOn univ n (smooth n-forms on ℝⁿ with compact support) and 𝒟_n(ℝⁿ) = GeometricCurrentOn univ n.

An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U ⊆ ℝ^P is the contract structure IMRep U n:
- M is Borel, M ⊆ U and M is countably n-rectifiable;
- θ : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable, positive on M, and ∫_{M∩K} θ dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U;
- ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n is strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞M, and for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there is a subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ x) Q.

R represents T when T(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). T is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity T) if some IMRep represents it. e_k = EuclideanSpace.single k 1 for k ∈ Fin n.

Statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let G ⊆ ℝⁿ be a Borel set (MeasurableSet G). Then there is an integer multiplicity current A ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝⁿ) with A(ω) = ∫_G ω(x)(e_0, …, e_{n−1}) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝⁿ). That is, [[G]] = τ(G, 1, e_0∧⋯∧e_{n−1}) is an integer multiplicity current.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : Set (Euclid n)), MeasurableSet G → ∃ A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity A ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid n)) n, A ω = ∫ x in G, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) x (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)) ∂μHE[n]
